Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A 1985 self-service gas station — digital price sign newly installed, a small convenience store where the second service bay used to be.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- propane tank exchange cage beside the building
- credit card readers not yet at pump
- price sign showing gas around $1.12
- main sign: "Citgo" branded gas station — Citgo pole sign with price display and Citgo colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'FREE COFFEE WITH FILL-UP', 'HOT DOGS 2 FOR $1'
- an 'AIR & WATER' sign at the lot corner
- squeegee buckets at the pump islands
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.


SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'Citgo'
'FREE COFFEE WITH FILL-UP'
'HOT DOGS 2 FOR $1'
'AIR & WATER'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a trucker checking his mirrors before pulling out
- a teenager filling a bike tire at the air hose
- a construction worker in a hard hat crossing at the light
Clothing: men in acid wash jeans, shoulder pads in blazers; women in big permed hair, high-waisted jeans. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 1984-1990 Dodge Caravan — first minivan, boxy — white
- 1981-1985 Ford Escort — small boxy economy hatchback — beige
- 1977-1990 Chevrolet Caprice — boxy full-size sedan, formal lines — silver
- 1978-1987 Chevrolet Monte Carlo — personal luxury coupe, long hood — red
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 1985 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 1985, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 1985.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: all angled into stalls along the far edge of the lot, the near stalls left empty. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- cottonwood tree at northeast corner of lot: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 35% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at sidewalk edge left of entrance: a young tree, only about 15% of its canopy in the base image, thin trunk
- cedar tree at back fence line: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 65% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1981-1985 Ford Escort — small boxy economy hatchback
1977-1990 Chevrolet Caprice — boxy full-size sedan, formal lines
1978-1987 Chevrolet Monte Carlo — personal luxury coupe, long hood
